title: Os.getNetworkInterfaces has been removed
summary: Node.js removed os.getNetworkInterfaces (DEP0023: runtime deprecation since v0.6.0, end-of-life since v12.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of os.getNetworkInterfaces with os.networkInterfaces().
